policy: Readiness is evidence-based. A division cannot be marked standby or operational solely because a plan or repository exists.

checks.name: Responsible owner and escalation route defined
Relevant automated and manual tests passed
Failure, recovery, and rollback procedures tested
Secrets, permissions, and data-handling review completed
Owner approval gates and prohibited actions enforced
Monitoring, reporting, and audit evidence available

evidence: Initial organisation charter and division registry added on a development branch.
Organisation Control Centre validator, dashboard builders, dependency report, work queue, incident, recovery, security and governance checks passed GitHub Actions run 43343966117.
open_gaps: Control Centre remains a draft feature branch; no merge, deployment or persistent live dashboard.
Division owners and escalation contacts need formal confirmation.
Several divisions still lack independently verified operating evidence.

evidence: Repository contains opportunity intelligence, division intake, engineering triage, deterministic risk review, finance/payout due diligence and executive reporting agents.
All AI Revenue workflow tests, Canadian employer ATS candidate validation, read-only feed collection, intake, triage, risk, finance and executive report steps passed run 43473069742.
open_gaps: Opportunity eligibility, platform terms, payout mechanics and individual leads still require source-level human verification.
No verified customer revenue recorded.
No approved customer acquisition, application, outreach or delivery workflow yet.

evidence: Repository README explicitly defines paper-trading-only scope.
Paper position lifecycle includes atomic partial exits, versioned stop/trailing/take-profit decisions, FIFO P&L reconciliation, persistent drawdown and allow-listed PAPER_ONLY state persistence.
All 135 then-current paper-engine tests and synthetic simulation passed run 43473656375.
Read-only Forex and Indices context specialists and their synthetic tests passed the 153-test suite in run 43474468908; specialist and position-engine scope is documented on a draft branch.
open_gaps: Position and exit-engine work remains on unmerged draft branches; no live capability is approved.
Independent Risk review of the position lifecycle, drawdown controls, ledger and recovery assumptions remains outstanding.
Current specialist modules consume caller-supplied synthetic/test data; permitted production data sources, provenance, licensing, freshness and outage handling are not yet integrated.
Forex and Indices are analysis-only foundations, not completed source-connected specialist services.
No durable hosted paper service, continuous monitoring, alerting or independently tested production recovery environment.
Historical/out-of-sample evaluation with realistic network fees, liquidity and slippage assumptions remains incomplete.
No live-trading readiness claim is permitted.

evidence: Read-only listing CSV audit MVP exists.
open_gaps: Major development intentionally deferred.

evidence: Long-term studio ambition recorded in strategic planning.
open_gaps: Expansion waits until the main organisation is successful and can fund it sustainably.

evidence: Organisation Control Centre validation and dashboard/report builders pass CI run 43343966117.
Paper position and specialist branches use automated GitHub Actions tests with pinned checkout/setup action references.
open_gaps: No approved merged or deployed shared infrastructure.
No durable host, secret-management review for production, or production monitoring.
Cross-repository integration and rollback exercise remain incomplete.

evidence: AI Revenue workflow collects public opportunity leads and read-only remote-work/employer ATS feeds; risk review and executive reporting passed run 43473069742.
Forex and Indices analysis-only specialist foundations are implemented and unit-tested in run 43474468908.
open_gaps: Individual opportunity leads require primary-source verification before use.
Forex and Indices lack approved source adapters, data licensing review, event calendars and independent market validation.
No complete research-to-risk-to-executive handoff has been independently tested.

evidence: AI Revenue workflow includes an automated finance and payout due-diligence report stage, passing run 43473069742.
open_gaps: Organisation-wide zero-budget cash baseline and revenue ledger schema have not been independently reviewed.
No bank/account integration or verified cash position is assumed.
Halal and fee-structure review remains required for any proposed financial product or strategy.

evidence: AI Revenue deterministic risk review and finance/payout risk handoff passed workflow run 43473069742.
Paper engine includes fail-closed input checks, exposure/drawdown limits, atomic fills, and state/ledger reconciliation tests.
open_gaps: Independent Risk Division review of Crypto position/exit controls remains outstanding.
Cross-division risk register, escalation ownership and stop-only advisory procedures need operational exercises.
Incident notification and recovery procedures are documented but not yet tested in a durable operating environment.
